newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down on heavy selling.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down on heavy selling.

text.p: Dhaka stocks ended 5.58 percent lower, the biggest drop in a single session in recent months, on heavy selling pressure, brokers said.
Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index fell 89.96 points or 5.58 percent to 1,515.96. Of the 101 issues traded, 42 ended up, 57 closed down and two were unchanged.
Eastern Cables lost 199.46 taka to 621.57, Bangladesh Tobacco Company shed 55.49 to 213.76 and Padma Textile gained 28.90 to 390.86.
Brokers said the prices fell because of a market correction following a rally over political stability and the goverment's pro-investment policy.
